column1: 5.5.4.2.9.8 Threat Type. When user clicks on this menu item a GUI, as shown in
Figure 5.71, shall be displayed. User shall check ‘Enable’ option, select required filter
parameter (Threat Type: Unknown, Hostile or Known) & and click on ‘Apply’ option to
enforce this filter or shall click on ‘Disable’ option to remove this filter on SCD Main Window.
